RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 23, 2008/Pausa 2, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister;  Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture;
Finance; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
103
New insurance policies sold by
insurance companies
*301. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA:  Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of new insurance policies
sold year-wise by the life, general and
medical insurers during the last five years,
indicating the numbers, volume of premium
deposited and volume of redemption
involved in respective categories;
(b) the details of insurance policies
renewed out of them and premium received;
(c) the details of life insurance policies
lapsed over the last five years due to default
by policy holders indicating their number
and volume of fund lying locked on account
of lapsed policies with Life Insurance
Corporation (LIC) and other insurance
companies; and
(d) the extant policy of Government
for utilisation of this locked insurance
fund?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Installation of modern air traffic
system at airports
†*302. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the airports where modern air traffic
system has been installed during the last
three years;
(b) the details of expenditure made by
Government in this regard;
(c) the details of benefits accrued to the
aviation sector as a result of it;
(d) the airports which have been enabled
for chartered flights during the said period;
(e) the names of places where
Monopulse Secondary Surveillance Radars
(MSSR) have been installed or proposed
to be installed; and
(f) the details of expenditure incurred
on these radars and the details of benefits
of installing MSSR?

104
Declaration of Ganga as National River
†*303. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS :
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken by
Government to give practical shape to the
declaration of the Ganga as the National
River;
(b) whether there is also a proposal to
stop some ongoing projects; and
(c) the measures being initiated to get
public cooperation in order to make this
plan successful?
Impact of terrorism on tourist arrival
in India
*304. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
DR. V . MAITREYAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the present level of tourist
arrivals in the country;
(b) what is the corresponding figures
during the last year;
(c) whether the arrival of tourists has
been severely affected due to the security
problem in the country on account of
terrorists activities in the country; and
(d) what serious measures are being
contemplated to improve the security in
the country to facilitate the tourist arrivals
in the country?
Upgradation of refineries
*305. SHRI  MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the public sector oil
companies propose to upgrade their
refineries and to equip them to process high
sulphur crude oil to cut their import bill;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the existing refining capacity of each
of the refineries of the public sector oil
companies and whether these capacities
have been fully utilised in the last few years;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pay disparity among Group ‘B’
Officers of various Ministries/
Departments
*306. SHRI  PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL :  Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Sixth
Pay Commission has not looked into just
demand of Group ‘B’ Officers of
Information and Broadcasting (I&B)
Ministry of granting them Group ‘A’ scale
after completion of four years of service;
(b) whether it is also a fact that officers
for the Railways, Accounts, Central
Secretariat Service (CSS), Central
Secretariat Stenographers Service (CSSS),
Delhi, Andaman and Nicobar Islands Civil
Service (DANICS) and Delhi, Andaman and
Nicobar Islands Police Service (DANIPS)
have been given better deal; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve career prospects of Group ‘B’
Officers of I&B Ministry?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

105
Social obligations of private sector oil
companies
*307. SHRI  DARA SINGH:
SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the present contribution of
producers in private sector oil Companies
in meeting their social obligations; and
(b) whether Government has not made
it obligatory by asking them to supply
petroleum products to Government
companies on Indian market prices before
allowing them to export the same on a very
high profit?
Scarcity of water
†*308. SHRI  BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI:
SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
scarcity of water in the country;
(b) if so, whether any initiative is being
taken by Government for the distribution
of water of Chenab, Kosi and Brahamputra
rivers under the international law; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Job loss due to economic
crisis
*309. MS.  SUSHILA TIRIYA:  Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
likelihood that lakhs of employees may have
to lose their jobs in the near future in view
of the global economic crisis;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Annual growth rate
†*310. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the mid term annual report of the Reserve
Bank of India (RBI), the annual growth
rate in the current year is expected to be
7.5 per cent to 8 per cent and according to
the Central Bank, the price index is expected
to rise upto 7 per cent in the current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether on the basis of the above
figures, the growth rate in the country can
be said to be satisfactory to the common
man; and
(d) if not, what is Government's
reaction thereto?
Loss in jobs and global financial
crisis
*311. SHRI  A. VIJAY ARAGHAV AN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
ever-increasing loss of employment in the
country due to the deepening global
financial crisis;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

106
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken to improve the economic sector;
(c) the details of action taken for labour
intensive projects, if any; and
(d) the expected loss of employment in
the country due to the deepening global
financial crisis for the period 2008-10, year-
wise  and category-wise?
Loss to Air India due to overbooking
†*312. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount being realised by
Government on account of overbooking of
tickets by Air India and the amount paid in
the form of compensation to passengers
each year from the year 2005 to October,
2008;
(b) whether a review of the losses
incurred is made by Government every
year; and
(c) if so, the steps taken to contain the
losses being incurred on account of
overbooking since 2005?
Poor in-flight services in
Air India
*313. SHRI  RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether in-flight service and quality
of food in Air India are very bad; and
(b) whether people are more attracted
to private airlines due to such a condition
in Air India?
Average rainfall in North-Eastern
Region
*314. SHRI  MA TILAL SARKAR:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the average rainfall in the country
and in the North-Eastern Region during
2007-08 and 2008-09 so far;
(b) the names of the States where
rainfall is above that average;
(c) whether Government has made any
assessment on the percentage of rainwater
consumed by the plants and animals during
2007-08;
(d) if so, the percentage thereof;
(e) whether Government is
contemplating any plan to restrict rain water
going waste; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Petrochemical project in
Vizag
*315. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether companies were now doing
a pre-feasibility study for a project of
14-15 million tonnes refinery and
petrochemical project in Vizag in Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the employment to be created for
the local people and their participation in
such projects; and
(d) the assistance of his Ministry to the
State Government of Andhra Pradesh in
this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

107
Security arrangements at
airports
*316. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether following the Mumbai
terror attack, his Ministry had a high level
meeting to assess aviation security in the
country and review security arrangements
at all airports;
(b) whether high level meeting was
attended by all Central intelligence agencies,
National Security Guards (NSG), Central
Industrial Security Force (CISF) etc.;
(c) if so, what concrete steps and
measures Government has taken to meet
the threat;
(d) whether it was decided that Air
Force and Civil Aviation authorities will
jointly have surveillance; and
(e) if so, to what extent this has been
finalized?
Uniformity of rates of petro products
in the Country
*317. SHRI  AMIR ALAM KHAN :
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the present rates of diesel, petrol,
cooking gas and kerosene in every State
and Union Territory;
(b) the difference of rates of various oil
products in each of the States and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether there is any proposal for
uniformity of rates in  all the States;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Amendment in Public Provident Fund
Scheme
*318. SHRI  RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR:  Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Karnataka
High Court has recently directed the Central
Government to amend Rule 3 of the Public
Provident Fund (PPF) Scheme, 1968 to
raise yearly subscription of Rs. 70,000/-
to Rs. 1,00,000/-;
(b) if so, whether the necessary
amendment has since been made; and
(c) if not, the reasons for delay and by
when the same is likely to be made so as to
ensure that the benefit thereof under section
80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961, accrues
to the subscriptions made during the
financial year 2008-09?
Monuments with ASI
*319. SHRI SABIR ALI:
SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of monuments with
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)
claimed to be wakf properties by various
Wakf Boards or organisations;
(b) the reaction of ASI thereto;
(c) the steps being taken to resolve the
situation; and
(d) the mechanism to prevent recurrence
thereof?

108
Impact of global economic
recession
†*320. SHRI  PRABHAT JHA:  Will
the PRIME MINISTER  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is also
affected by global economic recession;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has formulated
any scheme or set up any Commission to
assess the effects of this economic
recession;
(d) if so, the effects of the recession on
different sectors so far; and
(e) if not, the manner in which
Government would assess the fallout of
this recession?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 17th December, 2008 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 26, 1930 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Prime Minister : —

Corporate Affairs : —
Culture : 319,
Finance : 301, 306, 309, 310, 311, 318, 320,
Heavy Industries and Public
Enterprises : —

Tourism : 304,
